units.source_text: 我心想："假使金阁被烧掉了……

en.t: I thought to myself: "If the Golden Pavilion were burned down...

units.source_text: 假使金阁被烧掉了，这帮家伙的世界将会被改变面貌，

en.t: If the Golden Pavilion were burned down, the world of these people would be transformed,

units.source_text: 生活的金科玉律将会被推翻，列车时刻表将会被打乱，

en.t: the golden rules of their lives would be overturned, and the train timetables would be thrown into disorder,

units.source_text: 他们的法律也将会被变成无效的吧。"

en.t: and even their laws would probably be rendered invalid."
